parameters.site_description: A reproducible media optimization pipeline that explains every transformation.

hero.title: Transform media through plans you can inspect.
hero.description: OptiFlow resolves every conversion before mutation and retains evidence for the accepted output.

features.title: A bounded path from source to verified derivative.
features.description: Each stage produces evidence for the next review boundary.

items.title: Resolve transformations
items.description: Capture inputs, profiles, and expected changes before execution.

items.title: Run reviewed operations
items.description: Execute the selected profile without silently changing intent.

items.title: Measure the artifact
items.description: Check streams, dimensions, metadata, budgets, and provenance.

trust.title: Follow the evidence into durable surfaces.
trust.description: Architecture, policy, and source remain linked instead of compressed into a score.

finalCta.title: Start with one reviewable media plan.
finalCta.description: Use the documentation to resolve an input before applying any transformation.

footer.summary: Reproducible media optimization for inspectable creative systems.

product.name: OptiFlow
product.description: A reproducible media optimization pipeline with reviewable provenance.

documentation.title: OptiFlow documentation
documentation.introduction: Plan a transformation, review its intent, apply it, and verify the resulting artifact through one stable command model.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.summary: Resolve and inspect a first media plan.
pages.body: Run `optiflow plan` with a source and versioned profile. Inspect the emitted plan before passing it to `optiflow apply`, then verify the derivative.

pages.title: Optimization profiles
pages.summary: Use explicit quality and delivery targets.
pages.body: Profiles capture codecs, dimensions, metadata behavior, and output budgets without hiding the trade-offs behind one opaque quality score.

architecture.title: OptiFlow architecture
architecture.introduction: Intent, execution, and evidence stay separate so each handoff remains reviewable.
architecture.diagram:
flowchart LR
  source[Source media] --> plan[Resolved plan]
  plan --> transform[Transformation]
  transform --> artifact[Derivative]
  artifact --> evidence[Verification evidence]

decisions.title: Plan before mutation
decisions.summary: A transformation cannot execute until its input identity, profile, and expected output are captured.

decisions.title: Retain source provenance
decisions.summary: Every accepted derivative remains traceable to its source and transformation evidence.

legal.title: OptiFlow legal and trust
legal.introduction: Reviewed policy pages remain direct routes and identify their update boundary.

pages.title: License
pages.summary: Review the repository license before redistribution.
pages.body: The canonical license is published with the source repository and governs use of OptiFlow.

pages.title: Accessibility
pages.summary: The public site targets static, keyboard, and reduced-motion access.
pages.body: Report barriers through the OptiFlow issue tracker with the affected route, browser, and assistive-technology context.
